title: sl Module
content_markdown: The SL module allows OpenSIPS to act as a stateless UA server.
overview: The SL module allows OpenSIPS to act as a stateless UA server and generate replies to SIP requests without keeping state.
how_it_works: The SL module filters ACKs sent after a local stateless reply by inserting a signature into the to-tag.

exported_parameters.name: enable_stats
exported_parameters.description: If the module should generate and export statistics. Zero means disabled.

exported_functions.name: sl_send_reply
exported_functions.description: Sends a stateless reply with the given code and reason for the current request.
